channel.title: ebedesigns
channel.description: A focused collection of useful digital tools made for real everyday problems.

item.title: Meal Planning Organization Tracker Toolkit
item.description: A practical digital toolkit for households trying to reduce weekday decision fatigue. It turns meal planning organization into a repeatable workflow with editable trackers, printable HTML pages, plain-text instructions, and a quick-start guide. Files are designed to work with common spreadsheet and web-browser tools without a subscription.
